check_occlusion: use snap_point_is_occluded to raycast from a navmesh snap point and check if a target is occluded
snap_unoccluded_point: use unoccluded_navmesh_snap to find the closest unoccluded navmesh point near a 3D position via sampling and raycasting
snap_robot_embodiment: use embodied_unoccluded_navmesh_snap to find a valid robot placement on the navmesh considering collision and visibility constraints
check_path_navigable: use path_is_navigable_given_robot to simulate robot navigation along a path and check if collisions stay within a threshold
check_island_outdoor: use is_outdoor to classify a navmesh island as indoor or outdoor by raycasting upward and checking for ceiling hits
